task_scope: Numeric packet and timing statistics for one bidirectional flow within the analyzed capture.
aggregation_window: All packets in the uploaded capture with the same protocol-family and canonical endpoint tuple; no idle timeout or sub-flow window.

protocol_applicability.feature_math: Protocol-neutral for packets with the same observed network-layer length, timestamps, flow key, and direction.
protocol_applicability.runtime_inference: The current backend excludes ESP and IKE from model inference. IPv6 packet-length handling differs from IPv4 and is not covered by this contract.

directionality: Forward means packet source equals the lexicographically first (IP, port) endpoint; backward means the reverse. Ports are zero for protocols without transport ports.
preprocessing: No learned transforms; features are returned in the declared order using the runtime's aggregation and rounding rules.
missing_value_policy: Reject non-finite mandatory model inputs as insufficient_data; do not impute or zero-fill. A single-packet flow has undefined IAT values, and a zero-duration flow has undefined rates.
capture_point: Derived from packets in the uploaded capture; this contract specifies IPv4 network-layer packet lengths. The experiment report must record the capture interface and protocol.
missing_value_policy: Reject non-finite mandatory model inputs as insufficient_data; do not impute or zero-fill. A single-packet flow has undefined IAT values, and a zero-duration flow has undefined rates.

features.name: packet_count
features.definition: Number of observed packets in the bidirectional flow.
features.aggregation: Count all packets in the capture flow key.

features.name: byte_count
features.definition: Sum of IPv4 network-layer packet lengths; includes the IPv4 header and packet payload, excludes link-layer framing.
features.aggregation: Sum packet IP length across the flow.

features.name: flow_duration
features.definition: Elapsed time from the earliest to latest packet timestamp.
features.aggregation: Maximum timestamp minus minimum timestamp, rounded to four decimal places.

features.name: mean_packet_size
features.definition: Arithmetic mean of IPv4 network-layer packet lengths.
features.aggregation: Mean across flow packets, rounded to one decimal place.

features.name: std_packet_size
features.definition: Population standard deviation of IPv4 network-layer packet lengths.
features.aggregation: NumPy population standard deviation (ddof=0), rounded to one decimal place; zero for one packet.

features.name: min_packet_size
features.definition: Smallest observed IPv4 network-layer packet length.

features.name: max_packet_size
features.definition: Largest observed IPv4 network-layer packet length.

features.name: mean_inter_arrival_time
features.definition: Mean interval between successive packet timestamps, independent of packet direction.
features.aggregation: Sort timestamps, difference adjacent values, arithmetic mean rounded to five decimal places; undefined for one packet.

features.name: std_inter_arrival_time
features.definition: Population standard deviation of successive packet time intervals.
features.aggregation: Sort timestamps, difference adjacent values, NumPy population standard deviation (ddof=0), rounded to five decimal places; undefined for one packet.

features.name: min_inter_arrival_time
features.definition: Shortest interval between successive packet timestamps.
features.aggregation: Sort timestamps, difference adjacent values, minimum rounded to five decimal places; undefined for one packet.

features.name: max_inter_arrival_time
features.definition: Longest interval between successive packet timestamps.
features.aggregation: Sort timestamps, difference adjacent values, maximum rounded to five decimal places; undefined for one packet.

features.name: packets_per_second
features.definition: Packet count divided by flow duration.
features.aggregation: Calculated from packet_count and the four-decimal flow_duration; undefined for zero duration.

features.name: bytes_per_second
features.definition: Byte count divided by flow duration.
features.aggregation: Calculated from byte_count and the four-decimal flow_duration; undefined for zero duration.

features.name: forward_packet_count
features.definition: Packets from the canonical first endpoint to the second endpoint.
features.aggregation: Count packets whose source is the canonical first endpoint.

features.name: backward_packet_count
features.definition: Packets from the canonical second endpoint to the first endpoint.
features.aggregation: Count packets whose source is the canonical second endpoint.

features.name: forward_bytes
features.definition: Sum of IPv4 network-layer packet lengths in the forward direction.
features.aggregation: Sum packet IP length for forward packets.

features.name: backward_bytes
features.definition: Sum of IPv4 network-layer packet lengths in the backward direction.
features.aggregation: Sum packet IP length for backward packets.

features.name: direction_ratio
features.definition: Fraction of packets in the forward direction, not a byte ratio.
features.aggregation: forward_packet_count divided by packet_count, rounded to three decimal places.
